Write a pull request description for the current change.

Use the actual diff, issue/goal, tests, and repository PR conventions. Do not exaggerate what was validated.

Include:
- problem and solution summary;
- key design/root-cause rationale;
- main changed areas;
- security/privacy impact;
- compatibility/config/migration impact;
- automated checks run with results;
- manual validation completed or still required;
- rollback/risk notes;
- linked issue/acceptance criteria when known.

Keep it concise enough to review quickly.
